mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger demand ahead reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of expanding economy periods despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened financial market volatility from aggressive rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when FEDFUNDS >4% but not in tightening cycle, or positive in tightening

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and GDPC1 (demand) creates dual pressure on discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 both show upward trends over the past quarter
failure_condition: No significant correlation between CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 trends, or returns not positive when trends align

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong labor market growth reduces uncertainty and boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when PAYEMS rises but not in strong labor market, or low significance

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of CPIAUCSL above 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns over rising inflation eroding equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when CPIAUCSL >2.5% but not in inflationary pressure, or positive in such periods

mechanism_narrative: A contractionary monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) combined with expanding supply (INDPRO rise) reduces discount rates and enhances equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises while FEDFUNDS falls over the past month
failure_condition: INDPRO and FEDFUNDS move inversely but no positive returns, or weak correlation

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower unemployment and inflation reduce policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when UNRATE <4% but not in late-cycle, or high false positives

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong demand signals robust economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise over the past month
failure_condition: No significant correlation between HOUST and RSAFS, or returns not positive when both rise
